newsitem.title: USA: US cash crudes slip on products dive, grades ease.
newsitem.headline: US cash crudes slip on products dive, grades ease.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes ended weaker on pressure from softer NYMEX products futures prices, while grade differentials extended an easing pattern.

Outright cash crude exited the week around 30 cents lower at $26.10-20 a barrel for the spot February West Texas Intermediate/Cushing. Traders said the U.S. aftermarket window placed the spot crude within those ranges, around 3-9 cts higher than the regular Feb NYMEX close at $26.09.
Sweet grade barrels ended on the down side, shaving value all session on continued supply pressures and aggressively offered Brent barrels for the U.S. Gulf.
